answer: The design leans on per-identity stake bond plus peer re-execution of every receipt. Each submission hangs on the lagoon of a task receipt, and the vault is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Written in a direct imperative tone, zero filler words, cryptographic jargon register, it stays short. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the island of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
